messages:
marta: heads up — dashboards (sparklines + heatmap) are stalling on initial paint in prod/canary after last rollout. charts eventually render after a big jump in CPU and a large chunk arrives. :eyes:

sam: saw that too. seems tied to prefetch interactions? noticed a flurry of prefetch requests then immediate retries. cc @darren

darren: digging into logs — prefetch endpoint returning lots of misses. then client requests fallback chunk. there's a spike in KV cache churn. stack trace points to client-config TTL being 0ms for prefetches (so effectively disabled).

marta: where is PREFETCH TTL defined?

darren: in client-config + runtime overrides. rollout 3.9.7 set PREFETCH_TTL_MS -> 0 via feature-flag ff/prefetch-always-fresh. the intent was to avoid stale metric sets, but side-effect is constant miss -> bundle fallback.

elaine: additional datapoint: when fallback chunk is used we load a ~75kb polyfilled chunk instead of the thin runtime. that increases hydration time and pushes LCP out of SLO.

sam: repro quick check: ```
fetch('/api/prefetch?route=heatmap', {headers:{'x-prefetch':'1'}})
  .then(r=>console.log('x-cache-ttl', r.headers.get('x-cache-ttl')))
// prints: x-cache-ttl: 0
```

devex-bot: rollout bot: feature flag ff/prefetch-always-fresh enabled at 2026-03-19T22:05Z by pipeline `canary-rollout-3.9.7`

marta: proposal: revert ff/prefetch-always-fresh (restore TTL=300000ms), run canary for 30m, and add telemetry counters for prefetch_miss_rate + chunk_fallback_rate. also add a dashboard tile for first_paint_by_route so we catch regressions faster.

darren: agree. also add client-side fallback mitigation: if chunk fetch > 300ms, concurrently fetch the lightweight sparkline bundle to avoid blank UI. small change but should reduce user-visible jank while canary flips.

sam: i'll open CR with rollback + telemetry + client loader change. will include metric names and slices.

marta: thanks. @infra-bot can you schedule the revert on canary first and hold prod until metrics look good? :white_check_mark:

infra-bot: change CR-4821 created — revert ff/prefetch-always-fresh, PREFETCH_TTL_MS=300000 restored in canary. rollout scheduled in 10m window. link: https://infra.redwood/changes/CR-4821

elaine: please also add a short blurb in the release notes about prefetch tradeoffs (staleness vs latency) so product understands why TTL matters.

marta: adding to the rollout checklist: prefetch_miss_rate < 1% and chunk_fallback_rate < 0.5% before promoting.

sam: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/7852 — contains rollback + metrics + loader parallelize. request review from @darren @elaine

darren: reviewing now. if all good, will approve and merge, then monitor canary.

(more followups will be in the CR thread)
